overview: Whitchurch-Stouffville had 49,864 residents in 2021, up 8.8% from 45,837 in 2016, on 206.42 square kilometres. Growth outpaced the Ontario average, with new subdivisions adding households who are still choosing local providers.

Most residents live in Stouffville itself, while the rest of the town is rural hamlets and farmland. Many people commute out for work, so local businesses compete for evening and weekend attention close to home.
